advisory_headline.tr: Bosna-Hersek genelinde güvenlik seviyesi yüksektir; kırsal alanlarda mayın uyarı levhalarına dikkat edilmelidir.
advisory_headline.en: Exercise normal travel precautions; in rural hiking areas, heed marked unexploded landmine warnings.
advisory_headline.de: In Bosnien und Herzegowina gelten normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen; im ländlichen Raum auf Minenwarnungen achten.
advisory_headline.ru: В Боснии и Герцеговине нормальный уровень безопасности; вне городов не сходите с размеченных троп (мины).
advisory_headline.es: Aplican precauciones normales de viaje; en zonas rurales preste atención a señales de minas terrestres.

regional_warnings.area: Rural Forest and Former Confrontation Lines
regional_warnings.reason: Residual unexploded landmines remain in isolated off-trail forested areas; stick to marked trails.

source.title: BH MAC Bosnia and Herzegovina Mine Action Centre

esim_sim_notes.value: Bosnia is outside the EU; EU Roam Like at Home does NOT apply. However, Western Balkans regional roaming agreement allows zero-roaming fees with Montenegro, Serbia, and Albania. BH Telecom and m:tel offer tourist eSIMs.

source.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bosnia and Herzegovina

dos.title: Savor Bosnian coffee (Bosanska kafa)
dos.description: Drinking Bosnian coffee is a slow, cherished ritual; scoop the foam (kajmak) first, sip slowly, and enjoy the rahat lokum.

dos.title: Carry cash (BAM / KM)
dos.description: While large hotels and supermarkets accept cards, many traditional ćevabdžinicas and small shops in Baščaršija are cash only.

dos.title: Respect religious places of worship
dos.description: Dress modestly when entering mosques (Gazi Husrev-beg), Orthodox churches, Catholic cathedrals, and synagogues.

donts.title: Don't hike off marked paths in wilderness areas
donts.description: Always remain on clearly marked hiking trails and never ignore red skull-and-crossbones mine hazard signs.

donts.title: Don't discuss sensitive 1990s war politics casually
donts.description: The war remains an emotionally delicate subject for families across all ethnic communities; listen respectfully.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% is standard and customary in restaurants and cafes in Sarajevo and Mostar.
